description: Privilege-preserving synonym normalization across backend module RBAC allow-lists for the two CONFIRMED collapses only: (a) exam_officer / exam-officer -> examinations_officer; (b) system_admin -> platform_admin (by ADDING platform_admin alongside, never deleting, and in the two health PHI/break-glass files adding it with a reviewer-flag comment). nurse is NOT collapsed into school_nurse (distinct effective permission sets); parent/guardian stay distinct. All other alias spellings are explicitly out of scope and left byte-for-byte unchanged. Closes/advances PRC-M015 (normalization half), and contributes to PRC-M237, L174, M521, L276, L347, L391 vocabulary alignment.
steps: Read .agents/plan.md sections 0.1-0.3 and 0.5, and context.json, FIRST. Do not re-derive the synonym decisions; they are fixed.

Normalize examinations_officer: in packages/backend/assessment/src/assessment-access.ts replace the literals 'exam_officer' and 'exam-officer' with 'examinations_officer' in ASSESSMENT_STAFF_ROLES and REPORT_CARD_OPERATOR_ROLES, de-duplicating; in packages/backend/examination/src/examination-access.ts replace 'exam_officer' with 'examinations_officer' in EXAM_OFFICER_ROLES and the exam.delete array (examinations_officer already present -> drop the now-duplicate); in packages/backend/report/src/report-access.ts replace 'exam_officer' with 'examinations_officer' in EXAM_STAFF_ROLES. Leave board_officer and every other entry untouched.

Normalize system_admin -> platform_admin by ADDING 'platform_admin' to every ADMIN_ROLES/staff array that currently contains 'system_admin', keeping 'system_admin' in place (additive, no shrink). Files from the scan: assessment, attendance, communication, curriculum, dashboards/scope, etl, examination, fees, gradebook, hostel, library, lms, notification, parent-portal (consent/fees/messaging), registration, report, scholarship, staff, student (student-access, student-portal-access), timetable, transport, billing (billing-access), audit/routes.

In packages/backend/health/src/phi-field-acl.ts add 'platform_admin' to HEALTH_BREAK_GLASS_APPROVER_ROLES next to 'system_admin' and add a code comment: '// D2: platform_admin added as break-glass approver alongside system_admin; FLAG for security reviewer -- break-glass widening.' In packages/backend/health/src/health-service.ts add 'platform_admin' to TENANT_WIDE_HEALTH_ROLES and PHI_ACCESS_LOG_ROLES next to 'system_admin', with the same reviewer-flag comment. Never remove system_admin here.
Confirm nurse is left untouched everywhere (not merged into school_nurse); confirm no 'exam_officer'/'exam-officer' literal remains in production (non-test) backend code via a grep.

Update affected *.test.ts fixtures that assert on 'exam_officer'/'exam-officer' or on the exact pre-change allowed sets so they reflect canonical names; add a privilege-preservation test per changed module (see verification).

Run server-guard then per-module verification; commit locally with a message citing the relevant PRC ids (PRC-M015, PRC-M237, PRC-L174, PRC-M521, PRC-L276, PRC-L347, PRC-L391). Set this FEAT status to completed and record in findings: the exact list of files touched, the final grep result for exam_officer/exam-officer, and confirmation that every system_admin site also now lists platform_admin.
acceptance_criteria: No 'exam_officer' or 'exam-officer' string literal remains in any non-test file under packages/backend (grep returns nothing); 'examinations_officer' present where they were.
Every production allow-list that contained 'system_admin' now also contains 'platform_admin'; no allow-list lost any entry.
health phi-field-acl.ts and health-service.ts additions are ADD-only (system_admin still present) and carry the reviewer-flag comment.
nurse and school_nurse remain separate literals; parent and guardian remain separate.

A vitest privilege-preservation test exists per changed module proving each RBAC action's allowed-role set after the change is unchanged (exam normalization) or a superset that still admits every previously-admitted role and now also admits platform_admin (system_admin add).
pnpm --filter test green and tsc --noEmit clean for every changed package; eslint+prettier clean on changed files.
verification: grep -rn "'exam_officer'\|'exam-officer'" packages/backend --include='*.ts' | grep -v test  -> no output
per changed package: pnpm --filter <pkg> run typecheck
npx prettier --check <changed files> ; npx eslint <changed files>
findings:
DONE. Privilege-preserving synonym normalization across backend module RBAC allow-lists. PRC ids advanced: PRC-M015 (normalization half), PRC-M237, PRC-L174, PRC-M521, PRC-L276, PRC-L347, PRC-L391.

FILES TOUCHED (production source, 24):
- exam_officer/exam-officer -> examinations_officer: packages/backend/assessment/src/assessment-access.ts (ASSESSMENT_STAFF_ROLES both spellings -> single examinations_officer; REPORT_CARD_OPERATOR_ROLES both -> single); packages/backend/examination/src/examination-access.ts (EXAM_OFFICER_ROLES dropped duplicate exam_officer, examinations_officer already present; exam.delete array dropped duplicate exam_officer); packages/backend/report/src/report-access.ts (EXAM_STAFF_ROLES dropped duplicate exam_officer, examinations_officer+board_officer retained).
- system_admin -> platform_admin ADD (additive, system_admin kept everywhere): assessment, attendance, communication, curriculum, dashboards/scope.ts (COUNTRY_ROLE_IDS), etl, examination, fees, gradebook, hostel, library, lms, notification, parent-portal (consent/fees/messaging), registration, report, scholarship, staff, student (student-access x2 arrays, student-portal-access), timetable, transport. health/phi-field-acl.ts (HEALTH_BREAK_GLASS_APPROVER_ROLES) + health/health-service.ts (HEALTH_AUTHORIZED_ROLES, TENANT_WIDE_HEALTH_ROLES, PHI_ACCESS_LOG_ROLES) all with the reviewer-flag comment 'D2: platform_admin added ... FLAG for security reviewer -- break-glass widening.'
- billing/src/billing-access.ts: ALREADY contained platform_admin alongside system_admin; left unchanged (no edit needed).
- audit/src/routes.ts: AUDIT_WRITE_ROLES already includes platform_admin via the lowercased spread of PLATFORM_ADMIN_ROLE_IDS ({platform_admin, super-admin}); left unchanged (literal system_admin kept; parity satisfied).

TEST FILES: updated fixtures assessment/src/report-card-pdf.test.ts and report-card-reprocess-authz.test.ts (exam_officer -> examinations_officer role literals). Added privilege-preservation vitest tests: assessment, examination, report, staff, registration, timetable, transport (each proves every previously-admitted role still admitted + platform_admin now admitted alongside system_admin + fail-closed unchanged) and health/src/health-platform-admin-break-glass.test.ts (platform_admin can now approve break-glass AND act tenant-wide; health_admin+system_admin retain grants; unrelated roles still denied).

GREP RESULT for exam_officer/exam-officer: `grep -rn "'exam_officer'|'exam-officer'" packages/backend --include='*.ts' | grep -v test` returns NO OUTPUT (exit 1). examinations_officer present in assessment, examination, report, gradebook, examination/ops-service.

SYSTEM_ADMIN/PLATFORM_ADMIN PARITY: every non-test backend file containing system_admin also contains platform_admin (verified: the 'files with system_admin but without platform_admin' scan returned NONE). No allow-list lost any entry; health additions are ADD-only. nurse and school_nurse remain distinct literals (nurse in parent-portal/student files; school_nurse in health-service only). parent (18 files) and guardian (16 files) remain distinct.

VERIFICATION: pnpm test green for backend-assessment(185), -examination(233), -report(115), -staff(809), -health(136), -timetable(123), -transport(79), -registration(190); tsc --noEmit clean for all 22 modified packages; prettier --check clean on all changed files; eslint clean (0 errors) on changed source files. Pre-existing eslint debt in examination package (routes.ts/result-routes.ts/standalone-server.ts/document-generation-service import-order) is in files NOT touched by this change and is out of scope.

SCOPE NOTE: FEAT-001 covers only the normalization half (plan steps 1-2). Realm/catalogue extension (KEYCLOAK_REALM_ROLES, DEFAULT_ROLES, realm JSON, parity tests = plan steps 3-7) are separate FEATs and were NOT done here.
